instruction: Open VS Code, navigate to '/home/user/my-project', resolve the merge conflict in 'src/main.js', save, and commit with message 'Resolve merge conflict'.

command: mkdir -p ~/my-project/src && cd ~/my-project && git init && echo 'console.log("Base");' > src/main.js && git add . && git commit -m 'init' && git checkout -b feature && echo 'console.log("Feature");' > src/main.js && git commit -am 'feature' && git checkout master && echo 'console.log("Master");' > src/main.js && git commit -am 'master' && git merge feature || true
